title: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect
releaseBlockers: several products were renamed in 2026 (Vertex AI, Dataproc, Cloud Composer, Cloud Functions): check every product name before release
description: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect: every idea explained before it is tested, every card quoting the source words it rests on.
notice: Professional Cloud Architect and Google Cloud are trademarks of Google LLC. This deck is independent and is not affiliated with, sponsored, endorsed or approved by Google. BigQuery, Apigee and Gemini are trademarks of Google LLC; all other trademarks are the property of their respective owners. Portions of this deck are modifications based on work created and shared by Google and used according to terms described in the Creative Commons 4.0 Attribution License (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/); each card links to its source page on docs.cloud.google.com. No card uses exam content or the exam's case studies.

checks.what: Four independent audits read all 1144 cards against the Google Cloud documentation they quote, found word for word by the card checker, and the exam guide and compliance pages the rest are written from; no scenario reuses one of the exam's case studies
checks.result: One wrong card fixed (a product name spelled out wrongly); 8 unsupported claims removed, among them a claim that all Firestore databases replicate across regions; 4 ambiguous cards, among them a discount scenario and a slow-first-request scenario with a second defensible answer, and 6 unclear cards rewritten; 18 minor issues fixed.
